name: Lincoln County, WI
findings: Lincoln County has 125 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lincoln County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lincoln County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
